correctness.rationale: Each position j in Z_n has rank 1+nu_2(j). Offsets less than 2^(r-1) at a rank-r center match and offset 2^(r-1) mismatches (including seam cases), except at the highest rank where this offset is outside the allowed length. The only equal cyclic neighbors are at the a1-a1 seam, whose reflections give all even palindromes. This establishes complete explicit odd/even languages and exact counts for all positive n; finite checker independently compared predicted and enumerated sets for n=1..8.
